Admin access

For a real multi-device admin login, connect Supabase Authentication in Settings. The optional local PIN is a convenience lock only; it is not strong server-side security.

Backup & restore

Export all business records as JSON. Keep copies on a separate drive. Restore replaces the current workspace after confirmation.

CSV exports

Important records & data controls

Staff deletion is blocked when salary records exist. Invoice and salary deletion require confirmation. Cloud mode syncs the whole workspace document.

Do not share your Supabase service-role key. Use only the anon/public key in this HTML file.
